metadata.label_definition: churn=1 when no qualifying activity occurs during the complete future 14-day horizon.

governance.behavioral_feature_policy: Model features are restricted to observed behavioral activity features constructed before prediction time.
governance.target_leakage_policy: Future activity is used only for label construction and never for prediction-time features.
governance.human_review_policy: At-risk predictions are prioritization signals for Growth, not automatic adverse decisions about users.
governance.online_validation_policy: Offline predictive performance must not be presented as causal online intervention impact.

production_data_note: Synthetic demo data is not production evidence.
